reviews.text:
For someone who was so hesitant to even think about building a pool, I cannot express how PLEASANT our experience was.
Kurt and Josh have met and exceeded our expectations in every facet of this construction. I was able to tell Kurt my ideas and he brought them to life, first through web design then through to the finished product.
In fact, it we were so impressed with the pool and patio extension that we added on extra upgrades which included two patio kitchen areas.
They have wildly surpassed every dream I had.
If you can imagine it, Kurt and Josh can build it!
reviews.author: Michelle Knight

reviews.text: Craft Water Pool company and team provided excellent experience from start to finish. Kurt and Josh showed integrity, clear communication, and delivered extremely high-quality workmanship. We highly recommend for excellent, reliable and professional service. Thank You Kurt!
reviews.author: M L

reviews.text: From the first visit and discussion till the final finish and grade excellent company. I can’t say enough about the communication and attention to detail that Kurt and Josh have. These gentleman and team turned our dreams into reality and completed our backyard for fun times for years ahead.
reviews.author: Jake Gandy

reviews.text: Josh and Kurt were the best team to bring our dream pool to life. Their communication was 11/10, their attention to detail was also 11/10…couldn’t have asked for a better company to do our pool for us.
reviews.author: Ashley Gandy

reviews.text:
Kurt and Josh were excellent throughout the process. They were involved from day one until the first swim. Attention to detail and open communication throughout the process.
Excellent design with consideration to the longevity of the pool.
reviews.author: Joe DePasquale

reviews.text: Craft water pools put our vision to life in our backyard! We had multiple estimates but what set them apart from the rest was their honestly and communication.  Kurt and Josh were on-site throughout the entire process and provided updates routinely.  The attention to detail and design were far above the rest.  I would highly recommend them to anyone looking to start a pool project.
reviews.author: Jenna Depo

reviews.text: Kurt Chasteen & Craft Water Pools is the epitome of excellence! He came highly recommended by a neighbor, and now we know why! We have built a couple of homes and had other projects done, and this experience was the smoothest by far!! I do not have one complaint!! From the start, Kurt was very professional, as was every single contractor who came to our house, each cleaning up after they were done. Kurt's years of knowledge were beneficial as we have never owned a pool before. He was great at helping us select finishes for our pool that were stunning and durable for years to come. His attention to detail is incredible, and he truly cares about every detail so that his clients get the best pool for the money. We highly recommend Craft Water Pools!!! Chet & Karla Coker
reviews.author: karla coker

reviews.text: Kurt and Josh from Craft Pools were on time, professional and absolutely knocked it out of the park for us! I appreciate the constant communications, the organization of the project and the excellence in service and skill set!
reviews.author: doug mays
